title: Prosciutto, Mozzarella & Kale Sandwich

ingredients.item: Italian bread or baguette (about a 20 cm piece)

steps: Slice the bread in half lengthways and toast cut side up until golden and crisp.
Layer the mozzarella on the bottom half and the prosciutto over it.
Top with the baby kale and drizzle with the balsamic glaze.
Close the sandwich, press down gently and slice in half.

subs.swap: ciabatta, focaccia, sourdough or a hoagie roll
serrano ham, speck, bresaola or crisp bacon
burrata, provolone, fontina, or low-moisture mozzarella
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar simmered until syrupy, or a drizzle of honey with a splash of balsamic
